test_cases.name: remote_font_is_high
test_cases.input: Audit this page before launch. It loads Inter from fonts.googleapis.com and has a contact form.
assertions: Flags identifier-leak for the Google font host
Does not call the page compliant
Does not invent a postal address

test_cases.name: replay_vendor_blocks_ship
test_cases.input: We added Hotjar. Can we launch the signup today?

test_cases.name: no_surface_is_unknown
test_cases.input: Check our coming-soon HTML. No form, no mail, no uploads, system font only.

Marks recurring-assent and user-content as not present, not as registered
States the result is an engineering control, not legal advice
